description: This line plot, titled “ChatGPT on Movies,” illustrates the performance metrics—Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment—of ChatGPT as a function of Question Popularity, ranging from 15 to 55 on the linear x-axis. The y-axis, labeled “Values,” scales linearly from 0.86 to 1.00. The Accuracy metric, represented by a blue line with circular markers, begins at approximately 0.895 at Question Popularity 15, dips to 0.89 at 16, rises to 0.96 at 20, and then steadily increases to 0.985 at 55. The Confidence metric, shown as a green line with triangular markers, starts at approximately 0.98 at 15, fluctuates slightly upward to about 0.995 at 20, and then remains nearly constant at 0.995 through 55. The Alignment metric, depicted as a red line with square markers, begins at approximately 0.92 at 15, rises sharply to 0.98 at 20, and then gradually increases to 0.99 at 55.
